title: BUG: Index.get_indexer_non_unique misbehaves when index contains multiple nan

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

labels.name: Missing-data
labels.description: np.nan, pd.NaT, pd.NA, dropna, isnull, interpolate

body:
#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example

```python
axis = pd.Index([np.nan, 'var1', np.nan])
axis.get_indexer_for([np.nan])
```

#### Current Output

`array([-1], dtype=int64)`
Meaning that `np.nan` is not in axis which is incorrect and makes `df.drop(columns=[np.nan])` to fail when columns contains multiple `nan`.

#### Expected Output

`array([0, 2], dtype=int64)`
